prompt: Create an original 60 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; C major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective classical piece featuring a prominent string melody, likely a violin or cello, accompanied by a piano. The arrangement is elegant and expressive, with a gentle flow.
